description: This file defines the LogNode interface, which provides a contract for logging components that can output log messages and potentially chain multiple log targets. It specifies a method for printing log data with associated metadata, including log level, tag, message, and exception information.

classes.name: LogNode
classes.description: An interface that represents a logging node capable of outputting log information and chaining log targets.

methods.name: println
methods.description: A method to instruct a log node to output a log message with specified priority, tag, message, and exception information.
